users.rolesHelp: What each role can do and see. A person can have several roles: their access adds up.

desc.admin: See everything, set everything (couriers, users, prices)
desc.vendeur: The shop owner: orders, confirmation, tracking, stock, customers and ads (no users or settings)
desc.agent_manager: Does everything an agent does, and supervises: assigns / removes agents, follows their figures
desc.suivi: Follow parcels until delivery or return
desc.depot: Prepare, ship, receive returns, manage stock
desc.livreur: See their round, mark delivered / failed / returned

users.listHelp: People with this role. Click a row to edit, deactivate or change the password.
users.name: Name
users.passwordKeep: Leave empty to keep the current password
users.rolesHint: Several roles possible: access adds up.
users.deactivateConfirm: Deactivate this account? The person will no longer be able to log in.
users.resetConfirm: Generate a new password? The old one will stop working.
users.resetDone: New password (pass it on, it will not be shown again):
users.manageUsersLabel: Can create accounts and change passwords
users.manageUsersHint: For a manager or a supervisor: creates the team’s accounts and gives a new password to someone who forgot theirs. Never for administrators or for other people who have this right.
users.lockedHint: Only the administrator can change this account

help.confirmation: The statuses confirmation agents choose after each call.
help.depot: Confirmed orders to prepare, prepared, and returns received at the warehouse.
help.suivi: The parcel is with the courier: on the road, alert, returning…
help.livraison: The last mile: the rider is on the way, delivery failed, or the parcel is delivered.

status.helpMore: You can change the name, Arabic name and colour of each status. Original statuses cannot be deleted; the ones you add can. To change the order: drag a row. "Active" = offered to agents.
status.note: An added status "behaves like" an original status: e.g. "Customer hesitates" behaves like "Call back" (the order stays in the call-back list, with the new name).
status.name: Name
status.likeHint: The order follows the rules of this original status.

calls.title: Confirmation calls
calls.help: The 1st call is due X minutes after assignment, + Y minutes per more recent order to call first (last in, first called). Tries happen within the slots.
calls.cancel: Cancel after how many unanswered calls

pay.intro: Pay is computed from the orders: confirmed then delivered for agents, delivered team orders for managers, delivered for tracking, prepared for the warehouse, delivered (light / heavy) for riders.

paidOn.agents: Paid on: orders they confirmed that were delivered. Accounts with the "Confirmation" role appear automatically.
paidOn.managers: Paid on: delivered orders of their team's agents (Dashboard → Confirmation → teams).
paidOn.suivi: Paid on: delivered orders they followed.
paidOn.livreurs: Paid on: parcels they delivered, light or heavy by weight.

pay.upsellHelp: Paid on top of the pay plan, only for DELIVERED orders with a real upsell.

plan.agentsForm: + {{form}} per order typed by the agent

form.title: Edit plan · {{tab}}
form.thresholdHint: 0 = no threshold: every delivered order at the "above" rate.
form.form: Bonus per order typed by the agent (DA)

pay.slipsHelp: Computed for the chosen month with orders delivered (or prepared) that month.

fees.title: Delivery prices (customer)
fees.help: What the CUSTOMER pays for delivery, added to the order total. Create several prices (e.g. small products, big products) and tick each one's products: an order takes the price of its products. What YOU pay the courier is set in its Tariffs (Delivery companies).
fees.empty: No delivery price yet: orders use the courier's tariffs.
fees.createFirst: Create the first price (copy of current tariffs)
fees.isDefault: Default price (products without a chosen price)
fees.deleteConfirm: Delete the price "{{name}}"? Its products will go back to the default price.
fees.name: Name
fees.productsHelp: Tick the products that take this price. The others take the default price (or the one given to them).
fees.savHelp: Delivery price the customer pays for a SAV exchange, per wilaya. It is suggested on every ticket and can still be changed when the exchange is made.

channels.addHelp: Choose where your orders come from. Google Sheets is the simplest: paste the sheet link.
channels.listHelp: Each channel sends its orders to Confirmation. Shops and APIs send each order to the webhook. Active off = the channel no longer brings orders. SKU required = a line without a known SKU is refused.
channels.deleteConfirm: Delete the channel "{{name}}"? Orders already received stay.
channels.empty: No channel yet: pick one above.
channels.demoWarn: Demo mode: Pilotix runs in this browser, with no server on the internet. The webhook address shown is fictitious: Shopify, WooCommerce, YouCan… cannot send orders to it yet. Put Pilotix online first (Pilotix server).
channels.name: Channel name
channels.creator: Creator
channels.sheetUrl: Google sheet link (File → Share → Publish to the web)
channels.hookHelp: Your shop sends each order to this address (POST, JSON). It goes straight to Confirmation.
channels.rotateConfirm: Change the key? The old address will stop working: paste the new one in your shop.
channels.sampleNote: Products by "sku" (product or variant SKU). The wilaya is its number (1 to 69).
channels.afterSave: Save the channel to get its webhook address.

sheet.syncTip: Choose the columns and bring in the new orders
sheet.title: Sheet “{{name}}”: which column goes where?
sheet.help: The sheet has {{lines}} line(s). For each column of your sheet, choose where it goes in Pilotix. At least: Customer name, Phone, Wilaya and Product (or SKU).
sheet.dup: Two columns go to the same place: change one.
sheet.onlyNew: Do not import the {{lines}} lines already in the sheet (only new ones, from now on)
sheet.auto: Then Pilotix reads the sheet by itself every 2 minutes. A line becomes an order only once, even if you edit it later, and even if its order is confirmed, delivered, cancelled or deleted. Pilotix recognises a line by its Order number, otherwise by its Date + the phone: keep one of these columns.
sheet.result: {{created}} order(s) created in Confirmation › New · {{already}} already imported · {{errors}} line(s) refused

settings.shopNameHelp: Shown on delivery slips and sent to couriers.
settings.savPhoneHelp: Printed on the parcel labels: customers call this number for an exchange or a question.
settings.defaultCompanyHelp: When the order has no courier yet, the delivery cost (what you pay) comes from its tariffs.
settings.autoCancel: Cancel automatically after how many unanswered calls
settings.whatsappHelp: {nom} = customer name, {boutique} = shop name, {ref} = order reference.
settings.depotsHelp: Stock is counted per warehouse. Confirmed orders leave from the default warehouse.
settings.depotDeleteConfirm: Delete this warehouse? (only if never used)
settings.webHelp: Your website sends each order to this address (POST). It goes straight to Confirmation, with duplicates and blacklist checked.
settings.key: Key (in the x-webhook-key header or at the end of the address: ?key=…)
settings.noKey: No key yet: click "Change key" to create one.
settings.rotateConfirm: Change the key? Your website will need the new one.
settings.sampleNote: Products by "sku" (product or variant SKU). The wilaya is its number (1 to 69). "price" is optional (catalog price otherwise).
settings.cronHelp: ZR, Yalidine, EcoTrack… parcel statuses update when someone presses "Update" (Tracking page), and every 30 minutes from 7 am to 10 pm if you enable the automatic task below.
settings.cronSetupHelp: On the server, add this line to the crontab (crontab -e). It calls Pilotix every 30 minutes from 7 am to 10 pm (Algeria time).
settings.metaHelp: Pilotix reads your Meta spend and results (ad sets and ads, day by day) for the Ads page. The token stays on the server: it is never shown again.
settings.metaDisconnectConfirm: Disconnect Meta? The token is erased from the server.
settings.metaDemo: Demo: the Ads page figures are examples (no call to Meta).

testOrders.title: Test orders
testOrders.help: Orders with fake customers to try Pilotix for real: Confirmation, Depot, Follow-up… The customers are called “TEST …”, their numbers (0500…) do not exist and no message is sent.
testOrders.text: Create fake orders with your real products to test. They arrive in Confirmation › New. Delete them when you are done.
testOrders.deletedKept: {{count}} deleted. Already at the depot, cancel by hand: {{refs}}
